Diagrams: Diagram as Code for Python
details.claim_summary: Diagrams lets you draw cloud system architecture in Python code. It supports AWS, GCP, Azure, and Kubernetes.
details.documentation_snippet: Diagrams as Code allows you to track system architecture changes in version control. It was created for prototyping without manual visual tools. Requires Python 3.7+ and Graphviz.

details.title: Master Type-Safe React Routing with TanStack Router
details.claim_summary: TanStack Router provides 100% type-safe routing for modern React and full-stack web applications with search parameter validation.
details.documentation_snippet: TanStack Router brings first-class search param state management, route loaders, and compile-time route verification to React applications. It eliminates string-based navigation errors.

details.title: How to Break the AI Coding Agent Fix Loop
details.claim_summary: A practical guide on how to stop AI coding tools like Cursor and Copilot from hallucinating in endless bug loops.
details.documentation_snippet: Examines context window pollution in AI code editors. Demonstrates how to reset chat memory, constrain problem boundaries with unit tests, and provide minimal reproducing examples.

details.title: Scan of 250k Files Finds Tokens Stored in Browser LocalStorage
details.claim_summary: Empirical security analysis showing public web repositories and government sites regularly store raw auth tokens in browser localStorage.
details.documentation_snippet: Analyzed over a quarter-million web client files on GitHub. Discovered active authorization tokens vulnerable to trivial XSS exfiltration rather than secure HttpOnly cookie storage.

details.title: The Lightbulb Computer: Ambient Computing Without the Headset
details.claim_summary: A hardware prototype that screws into a standard light bulb socket, projecting an interactive computer interface onto desks.
details.documentation_snippet: Combines a micro-projector, computer vision camera, and onboard compute module inside a standard E26 bulb form factor. Tracks physical hand gestures on tables without requiring a VR headset.

details.title: Open WebUI: Self-Hosted Offline AI Platform
details.claim_summary: A user-friendly, self-hosted web interface for local LLMs supporting Ollama and OpenAI-compatible endpoints with RAG.
details.documentation_snippet: Open WebUI offers chat interfaces, model management, document vector retrieval, and authentication without vendor lock-in or recurring cloud costs.

details.title: Immich: High-Performance Self-Hosted Photo Management
details.claim_summary: Self-hosted alternative to Google Photos with AI facial recognition, timeline navigation, and mobile backup sync.
details.documentation_snippet: Immich runs on Docker with PostgreSQL and Machine Learning containers for facial recognition, object detection, and automated background phone backup.

details.title: Coolify: Self-Hosted Vercel & Heroku Alternative
details.claim_summary: An open-source PaaS to deploy applications, databases, and services to your own VPS with automated SSL.
details.documentation_snippet: Coolify manages servers, containers, domains, and Git webhooks. Lets developers deploy Next.js, Django, Postgres, and Redis with one click on any Linux server.

details.title: Prompt vs. Loop Engineering: Developer Guide to AI Workflows
details.claim_summary: Explains how to transition from brittle one-off LLM prompts to self-healing agentic feedback loops.
details.documentation_snippet: Compares static zero-shot prompting with programmatic evaluation and loop engineering. Shows practical patterns for automated validation and self-correction in Python.

details.title: Hoppscotch: Lightweight Open-Source API Testing Client
details.claim_summary: A web-first, minimalist API development ecosystem that operates offline and in-browser without Electron bloat.
details.documentation_snippet: Hoppscotch provides an intuitive visual request builder for REST, GraphQL, and WebSockets. Open-source, fast, and requires zero installation.

details.title: GitHub Stacked Pull Requests Enter Public Preview
details.claim_summary: GitHub rolls out native support for stacked pull requests to submit code in smaller logical layers.
details.documentation_snippet: Enables developers to split massive feature branches into chained, dependent pull requests. Reviewers can approve incremental PRs sequentially without merge conflicts.

details.title: PGSimCity: Visual Interactive Tour of PostgreSQL Internals
details.claim_summary: An educational cityscape visualization that illustrates how PostgreSQL handles memory buffers, WAL logs, and queries.
details.documentation_snippet: Interactive 3D representation converting database storage engines into traffic and building visual metaphors. Designed to help students understand relational database internals.

details.title: Multi-Region Raft Lease Optimization in CockroachDB v24.2
details.claim_summary: Technical deep-dive on epoch-based leaseholder transfers and cross-continental latency tuning for distributed SQL clusters.
details.documentation_snippet: Focuses on WAN round-trip consensus benchmarks, p99 latency guarantees in geo-distributed partitions, and Raft consensus log compaction.

details.title: Convergence Guarantees for Stochastic Gradient Descent in Sobolev Spaces
details.claim_summary: Mathematical proofs of bounding Lipschitz gradients in infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces for non-convex optimization.
details.documentation_snippet: Contains theoretical mathematical lemmas, Sobolev inequalities, and asymptotic convergence proofs without software implementation or practical code.

details.title: Oracle Acquires Enterprise Compliance Vendor for $3.2B in Cash
details.claim_summary: Financial disclosure of a corporate merger to expand enterprise HIPAA audit solutions for healthcare clients.
details.documentation_snippet: Discusses stock share ratios, EBITDA multiples, quarterly fiscal earnings, and executive board approval for enterprise cloud compliance.

details.title: BGP Anycast Routing and Calico eBPF Kernel Mesh Configuration
details.claim_summary: Guide to configuring hardware BGP peering across 10,000 node Kubernetes bare-metal telecommunication backbones.
details.documentation_snippet: Covers kernel socket splicing, hardware router BGP peer groups, and multi-datacenter ASN configuration for telecom networks.

details.title: Open WebUI v0.5.2 Bugfix Release
details.claim_summary: Minor patch update for Open WebUI fixing a typo in dark mode settings dialog.
details.documentation_snippet: Release notes for v0.5.2: Fixed CSS padding in settings modal, updated French translations. No new architectural features.

details.title: Immich v1.118 Patch Notes
details.claim_summary: Minor patch release fixing background notification crash on Android 12 devices.
details.documentation_snippet: Bug fix update resolving Android notification channel initialization. No major feature additions.

details.title: TanStack Router v1.45.1 Dependency Bump
details.claim_summary: Internal dependency updates and typo correction in documentation for TanStack Router.
details.documentation_snippet: Bumps devDependencies and corrects markdown spelling in README. No functional changes to router API.

details.title: QuantumPy: 10,000x Faster Execution Than C++ Via Quantum Simulation
details.claim_summary: QuantumPy claims to beat optimized C++ by 10,000x on ordinary CPUs using quantum state simulation.
details.documentation_snippet: README: A weekend hobby Python script experimenting with matrix multiplications. Note: Not tested against C++ and runs slowly on standard laptops.
details.flagged_contradiction: Claims 10,000x speedup over C++, but documentation admits it is an unbenchmarked hobby script that runs slowly.

details.title: AutoDev: Full Autonomous Senior AI Software Engineer
details.claim_summary: An autonomous software developer that writes entire full-stack apps and deploys them to AWS with zero human supervision.
details.documentation_snippet:
# AutoDev

Coming Soon! Star this repo to stay tuned. Join our Discord for updates.
details.flagged_contradiction: Empty repository containing zero code, only a marketing placeholder.

details.title: ZeroCostDB: 100% Free Unlimited Cloud PostgreSQL Forever
details.claim_summary: Provides completely free, unlimited database storage without credit card or tier restrictions forever.
details.documentation_snippet: Terms of Service: Free tier limited to 50MB and expires after 7 days unless upgrading to the $29/month Pro subscription.
details.flagged_contradiction: Claims infinite free database forever, but documentation reveals a strict 50MB 7-day trial requiring payment.

details.title: fx: Terminal JSON Viewer and Processor
details.claim_summary: Terminal JSON viewer and processor written in Go.
details.documentation_snippet:
# fx

Interactive command-line JSON viewer. Usage: `curl ... | fx`.

details.title: WebVM: Linux Virtual Machine Running in the Browser via WebAssembly
details.claim_summary: Serverless Linux environment running client-side in the browser using CheerpX WebAssembly virtualization.
details.documentation_snippet: WebVM virtualizes x86 binaries inside browser WebAssembly. Still experimental with limited network socket support and file persistence limitations.

details.title: fzf: A Command-Line Fuzzy Finder (⚡ 汎用ファジーファインダー)
details.claim_summary: An interactive, ultra-fast Unix filter for command-line search and file navigation.
details.documentation_snippet: fzf is a general-purpose command-line fuzzy finder. It can be used with any list: files, command history, processes, git commits.
